Two cameras work together: the front-facing camera focuses on people while the downward-facing camera covers the floor in front of your door.
An industry-first dual-light system with an advanced light capturing and processing algorithm delivers less blur than previous night vision and a clear night view of up to 16 ft (5 m).
2K resolution reveals more detail, giving you clear visuals of your doorstep and anyone who drops by.

Battery mode makes installation easy and a spare quick-release battery avoids downtime while charging. Wired mode also runs from the battery, which is topped up by a power source of 8 to 24V and more than 10VA.

Connects to your existing chime, or pairs with eufy HomeBase S280, eufy HomeBase S380, eufy Minibase Chime (T8023), Alexa devices and Google Assistant devices. It is not compatible with the original eufy Wi-Fi Chime (T8020) or eufy Chime (T8740/T8742).
Compatible with eufy HomeBase S380 running firmware version V3.3.2.6 or later.
